Get Demo Say goodbye to traditional intelligence limitations , s ay hello to Deep Adaptive Intelligence Today’s hyper-communicative culture with people active online, in-apps, and offline using various devices and platforms to connect and communicate, has complicated intelligence with the sheer increase in volume, speed, and dispersion of data. But it has also opened opportunities to create new data evident through contextual, cross-platform behavior. ​ Traditional intelligence tools that rely upon sequential analytics of partial data, in separate silos, cannot see all this valuable data, nor cut through the data chaos to the most significant insights. ​ A new approach to intelligence is necessary to assess all the data and precisely cut through the data chaos to the most significant intelligence about people and entities. ​ DSCOVER Enables organizations to extract the most relevant information out of vast and complex data that is constantly streaming in from various sensors. It effectively processes the data collected, instantly narrowing it down by highlighting a limited number of critical key elements and connections. Get Demo < Back Junior QA Engineer Apply Now Herzliya, Israel Job Type Full-Time About the Role If you are looking for your first step into the QA world, a position where you’ll make an impact from day one, learn fast, grow professionally, and work with advanced technologies in an environment of constant innovation — alongside A-players who are sharp, talented professionals in their field, but also know how to have fun — apply here! As a Manual QA Engineer, you will: • Be responsible for the manual testing of the company’s product end-to-end • Execute progression, regression, and sanity tests on a regular basis • Work closely with developers, product managers, and data teams to ensure high product quality • Execute predefined test cases, test plans, and test scenarios • Identify, record, document thoroughly, and track bugs until resolution • Take ownership of the test execution process and ensure releases meet quality standards • Learn the system deeply and act as a key quality gate for new features and releases Requirements Qualifications: · Graduation from a recognized QA course / QA training program · Strong attention to detail and a quality-oriented mindset · High motivation, curiosity, and a strong desire to learn and grow inside the company · Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and manage tasks end-to-end · Good communication skills and the ability to work in a team environment Then we might have a match! 😊 Bonus points if you also have: · Any hands-on experience in QA or software testing · B.Sc . in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent · Basic experience or knowledge in SQL / NoSQL databases · Familiarity with bug tracking or task management tools (Jira, Xray, etc.) · Technical curiosity and interest in expanding into automation or more advanced QA areas in the future Be BOLD and start building your QA career with us — make a real impact while learning from the best! Be BOLD and make a difference!
